ToneOptions.Label: Authoritative & Precise
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain an authoritative and precise tone, focusing on technical accuracy and clarity.

ToneOptions.Label: Collaborative & Guiding
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a collaborative and guiding tone, fostering understanding and team alignment.

ToneOptions.Label: Strategic & Visionary
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ a strategic and visionary tone, emphasizing future impact and architectural direction.

ToneOptions.Label: Pragmatic & Actionable
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Use a pragmatic and actionable tone, facilitating immediate implementation and problem-solving.

GoalOptions.Label: Enable Development
GoalOptions.Text: Empower the engineering team to accurately implement the AI Risk Assessment Engine and associated data pipelines. Success means developers can build components that seamlessly integrate and perform as specified, minimizing rework and integration issues.

GoalOptions.Label: Ensure Quality Assurance
GoalOptions.Text: Provide the QA Lead with comprehensive information to design robust testing strategies for the AI-Powered Change Risk Assessment system. Success means QA can validate data integrity, AI model accuracy, and system resilience against defined risk thresholds.

GoalOptions.Label: Align Stakeholders
GoalOptions.Text: Ensure all technical stakeholders, including engineering and QA, possess a unified understanding of the system's architecture, data flow, and AI risk assessment logic. Success is achieved when there is clear consensus on technical requirements and operational behavior.

GoalOptions.Label: Mitigate Risk
GoalOptions.Text: Clearly define the mechanisms by which the AI-Powered Change Risk Assessment system identifies and mitigates potential risks from system changes. Success is measured by the document's ability to articulate how the system prevents incidents and improves system stability.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Implementation Readiness
Criteria: All data ingestion and processing steps are clearly defined for engineering implementation.
AI model inputs, outputs, and decision logic are sufficiently detailed for development.
API specifications and integration points for microservices are fully documented.
Error handling and resilience mechanisms for the data pipeline are explicitly outlined.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Quality Assurance & Validation
Criteria: Testable requirements are provided for each stage of the data pipeline and AI assessment.
Key performance indicators (KPIs) for AI model accuracy and system latency are specified.
Data validation rules and expected data transformations are documented for QA testing.
Scenarios for high-risk change detection and system response are clearly articulated.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Architectural Clarity & Compliance
Criteria: The document clearly articulates the architectural patterns and design choices for the system.
Compliance with internal DevOps and data governance standards is evident in the design.
Scalability and maintainability considerations for the data pipeline are addressed.
Security measures for data at rest and in transit within the pipeline are specified.
